name.title: DP_DATA_CATALOG_DMP
name.sysdesc: A data product that contains the contents of the data catalog filtered per the command arguments.

field.sysdesc: The creation time filter start commanded when this data product was requested. The data product includes all products in the catalog whose product creation time is after this time.
The creation time filter end commanded when this data product was requested. The data product includes all products in the catalog whose product creation time is before this time.
The data validity time filter start commanded when this data product was requested. The data product includes all products in the catalog whose product DVT is after this time.
The data validity time filter end commanded when this data product was requested. The data product includes all products in the catalog whose product DVT is before this time.

The APID range filter commanded when this data product was requested. The data product includes all products in the catalog whose APID equals this filter. A value of 0 represents that all APID are eligible for inclusion.
Flag indicating whether catalog entries in the SENT state are included in data product.
Flag indicating whether catalog entries in the UNSENT state are included in data product.
APID of the data product.
Size of the data product file in bytes.
Time (SCLK seconds) when the data product was opened for writing.
Time (SCLK sub-seconds) when the data product was opened for writing.
Data validity time (SCLK seconds) of the data product.
Data validity time (subseconds) of the data product.
The downlink packetization priority (1-100) of the data product.
Total number of parts that make up the data product (valid range between 0-1024). If the file is still open the value will equal 0.

The start of the range of parts that are marked as UNSENT (valid range between 0-1024). If the product is still open this value will be set to 0. If the product is closed and completely sent this value will be set to 0.

The start of the range of parts that are marked as UNSENT (valid range between 0-1024). If the product is still open this value will be set to 0.If the product is closed and completely sent this value will be set to 0.

This is the internal state of the data product. WRITING = state indicating that the product is being written to. QUEUED = state indicating that the product has been closed after write and not yet selected for downlink. DOWNLINKING = state indicating that the product is currently being packetized and downlinked. TRANSMITTED = state indicating that the product has been completely downlinked (all parts sent). CORRUPT = state indicating that an error was encountered while packetizing the product. Note that data products in the "WRITING/DOWNLINKING" state are considered busy and can not be deleted or modified.

This is the storage state of the data product. COMPRESSED = The product is compressed (and on EFS). COMPRESSING = The product is currently being compressed, but the compression has not yet completed. DECOMPRESSING = The product is currently being decompressed, but the decompression has not yet completed. DECOMPRESSED = The product is not compressed. LINKED = The product is a linked data product that physically resides on BDS. Note that data products in the "WRITING/DOWNLINKING" state are considered busy and can not be deleted or modified.

This is the transmission type for the data product. FULL_TRANSACTION = The product will be downlinked as a full CFDP transaction. MPDU_ONLY = Only the MPDU will be downlinked when the product is selected for packetization. DPDU_ONLY = Only the DPDUs for the indicated part range will be downlinked when the product is selected for packetization. EPDU_ONLY = Only the EPDU will be downlinked when the product is selected for packetization.
Boolean flag. 0 if tag update is not pending for this entry, 1 if tag update is pending for this entry.
Checksum (CRC32) of the data product.
The source string id of the data product.
